scope: Scoped current-render city massing/window installation and retained furnishing/entrance clearance review. No whole-environment photoreal, gameplay, human or full-V2 acceptance. Distant fog/ground continuity, repetitive timber, strong lamp hotspots and simple artwork remain open.

images.observation: The retained landing artwork clears the rail and panel cap. Its simple graphic and flashlight hotspot remain appearance work.
The complete frame is above the eye rail and the doorway remains clear. Small graphic content remains visually coarse.
All six prints and end supports sit above the eye rail; no rail cuts through their visible stock.
Wardrobe stock stands forward of the corner skirting. Wood repetition and the strong flashlight highlight remain appearance debt.
Wall cupboard and sink remain installed; rail passes behind the projecting supported cupboard. Bright finish and simple cabinet detailing remain appearance work.
Retained washer supply pipes and supports remain seated above the wall finish; no missing cold/hot line. This is a scoped installation comparison, not mechanical or photoreal acceptance.
Native entrance, marquee, blade and window trim remain intact after landing integration. Simplified stone/wood shading remains broader appearance work.

Continuous primary stone elevations and a single upper crown replace the repeated setbacks. Recessed sash and varied shade drops are visible. Distance fog still flattens stone contrast; no whole-city appearance grant.
The surrounding skyline retains its actual mast and water-tank silhouettes over continuous elevations. Atmospheric flattening remains broader appearance work.
The east skyline keeps roof plant and its existing bearings; repeated terrace tiers are absent from the main elevation. This posed roof view proves no walking route.
The actual street perspective retains the Orison foreground and shows reworked neighbouring massing at the left; it is not a complete street sweep.
The upper window has an actual clear first-hit sightline past the construction canopy. Recess, painted sash, stone sill and varied curtain drops are visible beside the retained Orison.
Brick and stone elevations remain distinct. Visible window returns, sills and lintels meet the corner without the prototype coplanar overlap.
Continuous masonry and recessed windows are visible from the clear upper station. Finite distant ground/horizon continuity and repetitive stock remain broader world work.
